description:
I met a young obsessive seme inside a dark, adult BL novel. His name was Sislein, the crown prince seme, who would eventually turn evil after being tormented by the uke and commit all kinds of terrible deeds. “If he isn’t bullied in the first place, then it should lead to a happy ending, right?” For the sake of the uke’s beautiful future, I saved the young obsessive seme, but… He turned out to be far cuter than I expected?! My baby, I’ll protect you! I fed, raised, and pampered the low-self-esteem obsessive seme, and even introduced him to Heinrey, the novel’s “uke.” Wishing for my favorites to find happy love together, I left with a light heart—but then… “Annette is still so small. I’m not.” “You promised you wouldn’t leave me. For a child who breaks her promises… what kind of punishment would be best?” “These humans are a gift. You said you wanted to raise intelligent pets, didn’t you?” I only raised those kids for the sake of a happy ending, but now those terrifying obsessive semes are trying to devour me. Why? What on earth happened…?
